info.description: Collaborative platform for the automated creation of music videos for music groups.
info.title: Mybandnow API

tags.name: Mybandnow
tags.description: REST API that allows you to do a mybandnow

get.description: Get a song instrument for a song when the authenticated musician belongs to the song band.

patch.description: Update the metadata of an existing song instrument slot when the authenticated musician owns the song.

200.description: The song instrument has been updated

patch.summary: Assign or reassign a musician to an existing song instrument
patch.description: Update the musician assigned to an existing song instrument slot. If the musician is not already in the song band, the backend creates a MEMBER band link automatically.

200.description: The song instrument assignment has been updated

post.summary: Invite an existing musician to the song band and assign the instrument synchronously
post.description: Resolve an existing musician profile by email, ensure the musician belongs to the song band as MEMBER, and assign the musician to the instrument slot. True email invitations are out of scope for this POC.

200.description: The musician has been linked to the band and assigned to the song instrument

patch.summary: Update song instrument video sync metadata
patch.description: Update the synced playback start time for a song instrument video when the authenticated musician belongs to the song band.

post.summary: Upload a song instrument video for asynchronous validation
post.description: Send the multipart/form-data field named video with an MP4 file for a specific song instrument participation.

video.description: MP4 video file uploaded in the video field

get.description: List songs that belong to bands where the authenticated musician is the owner or a member.

parameters.name: criteria
parameters.description: A JSON string for filtering, sorting, and pagination. Supported song fields include id, bandId, and title.

200.description: The songs visible to the authenticated musician

post.summary: Request videoclip generation for a song
post.description: Validates that every song instrument has an uploaded video and, if so, starts the asynchronous videoclip generation process.

202.description: The videoclip generation process has been requested

delete.summary: Cancel a pending videoclip generation process for a song
delete.description: Cancels the videoclip generation process for a song when it is still in PENDING status.

204.description: The videoclip generation process has been cancelled

post.description: Create a song instrument for a song owned by the authenticated musician. The song owner may assign any existing musicianId.

201.description: The song instrument has been created

get.description: List song instruments for a song when the authenticated musician belongs to the song band.

parameters.name: criteria
parameters.description: A JSON string for filtering, sorting, and pagination. The song scope is always forced from the path songId.

200.description: The song instruments of the song

requestBody.description: A JSON object containing band information

get.summary: Get a list of band by criteria
get.description: Get a list of band by criteria

parameters.name: criteria
parameters.description: A JSON object for filtering, sorting, and pagination. Example: `{"filters":[{"field":"name","operator":"CONTAINS","value":"test"}],"orderBy":"name","order":"asc","limit":10,"offset":0}`

get.summary: List the members of a band
get.description: List the members of a band when the authenticated musician is the owner or a member.

post.summary: Add an existing musician to a band by email
post.description: Create a MEMBER band membership for the musician resolved from email. Invitations are not implemented in this POC.

201.description: The band member has been created

get.summary: List the songs of a band
get.description: List the songs of a band when the authenticated musician is a member.

post.summary: Create a song under a band
post.description: Create a song for a band where the authenticated musician is a member.

requestBody.description: A JSON object containing the fields to update

get.summary: Get a list of instruments by criteria
get.description: Get a list of catalog instruments by criteria

parameters.name: criteria
parameters.description: A JSON object for filtering, sorting, and pagination. Example: `{"filters":[{"field":"name","operator":"CONTAINS","value":"guitar"}],"order":{"orderBy":"name","orderType":"asc"},"limit":10,"offset":0}`

get.description: Get a catalog instrument by ID

put.description: Update a catalog instrument by ID

requestBody.description: A JSON object containing the fields to update

NotFound.description: The specified resource was not found.

Conflict.description: The specified resource has a conflict.

ProfileNotFound.description: The authenticated user does not have a musician profile yet.

musicianEmail.description: Must belong to an existing user with a musician profile. Invitations are out of scope for this POC.

instrumentId.description: Must reference an existing instrument in the Instruments catalog.

musicianId.description: Identifier of the musician to assign to the song instrument.

musicianEmail.description: Must belong to an existing user with a musician profile. True email invitations are out of scope for this POC.

id.description: Client-generated identifier for the videoclip generation process.

instrumentId.description: Must reference an existing instrument in the Instruments catalog.

musicianId.description: Must reference an existing musician. The authenticated song owner may assign their own musician profile or another existing musician.
